allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated February 23, 2026, titled "Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited Receives Land Allotment Approval for Proposed HFO Manufacturing Plant in Rajasthan".

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding : Submission of Letter of Offer for Rights Issue of Fully Paid-up Equity Shares of Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited .

allot.subject: Rights Issue
allot.text: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on February 05, 2026, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 19 : 41, i.e 19 Equity Shares for every 41 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is 99 per share.

allot.subject: General Updates
allot.text: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange about the In-Principal approval for Proposed Rights issue of the Company.

allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated January 20, 2026, titled " Stallion India Fluorochemicals Strengthens Expansion Plans with RIICO Industrial Plot Allotment to Support R-32 Manufacturing Facility ".
